name: gantt-project-app
description: Aplikasi manajemen proyek Gantt Chart (React + Express + Prisma SQLite)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w shared && tsx server/prisma/seed.ts
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed --schema server/prisma/schema.prisma && npm run db:seed
